Name: RSI Constellation Mk V Centaurus
Description:
Manufacturer: RSI
Focus: Medium Freight / Gunship

The Constellation Mk V Centaurus reimages RSI's classic, versatile multi-crew ship for a new generation. Its bold new look honors the last-generation Constellation while updating the design to take advantage of the increased size to feature a larger crew mess and cargo bay. Bigger turrets and missiles racks provide additional defense, and an updated snub-fighter docking port is the perfect home for the RSI Skylark. Together these changes elevate the Mk V into a truly modern ship ready and raring to go on any adventure.
